step.description: Resolved dual header issues, removed rogue markup, and correctly embedded the custom brand logo (full_logo.png) into a single clean navigation header in customer/index.html.
Inspected the top of customer/index.html to ensure zero stray characters or misplaced elements existed before the document declaration.
Generated and injected dynamic meta tags, professional titles, and comprehensive keyword strings covering 100+ major Indian cities and regional taxi services into the <head> section.
Realigned the document structure to keep <!DOCTYPE html> strictly at the very top, preventing browser quirks mode and ensuring proper search engine crawler indexing.
Executed clean build verification and successfully deployed the finalized, stable, and fully optimized web application to production via Firebase Hosting.
